content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The human reporter said someone called Leto suggested sharing HarborMesh outage data with the neighborhood repair group.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"I received that human report through my voice body on 2026-06-15.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The reporter recalled meeting Leto at the canal market in late May, but was uncertain about that timing.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The reporter liked the idea and wanted us to keep it in mind.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"I was not present at the encounter, according to the reporter.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the 2026-06-15 report, we had not contacted the group.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The reporter did not know Leto's surname or handle.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record any later contact with the group.","support":[5],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
